memorial.name: Mira Vale — fictional submission
memorial.description: A fictional community gardener remembered for sharing seeds, patient teaching and welcoming neighbours. All details are invented for this demonstration.

guestbook.message: Remembering the welcome Mira gave everyone at the garden gate. This is an invented demonstration message.

tributes.content: At our first seed-sharing morning, Mira noticed that the new volunteers were standing at the edge of the group. She set out extra chairs and asked each person what they hoped to grow. Soon everyone was comparing notes and laughing about their failed tomatoes. She made room for beginners without making them feel small. This event, the volunteers and Mira are entirely fictional demonstration material.

On rainy afternoons Mira brought a flask of tea to the little garden shed. We would mend labels and sort tools while she listened to whoever needed to talk. She never rushed a conversation. Once we spent an entire afternoon repairing a bent watering can because she thought useful things deserved another chance. The tea, the shed and our friendship are fictional details created for this demonstration.

Mira always kept a small tin of spare seeds beside the garden gate. When I admitted I had never grown anything, she handed me a paper envelope and helped me choose a sunny patch. She returned the following weekend to show me how to water the seedlings gently. I remember her patience more than the harvest. This memory and every person in it are invented for the demonstration.
